_doc: Limits for tools/metrics.mjs, set from the hardened cheetah (seed 1) with modest headroom. Every check passes when value <= limit. S = mean leg-chain length of the individual (m). Pops and jitter are sampled at popHz; rad/s* = angular rate x sqrt(S / refLegLength) / max(1, sqrt(Fr / popFroude)).

mesh._doc: holesExposed: open boundary edges of the meshed skin that are visible at any quality tier (not hidden by a cross-fade, not buried in another part); a viewer looks into the body through them. 0: the skin is closed wherever it can be seen.

plans._doc: Per body plan: sampleHz = motion sampling rate (a swimmer's tail beats at up to ~15 Hz; at 60 Hz that oscillation reads as jitter); extra plan checks and their limits (% S, rad).
